lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Type the email address for your back-office account. [[slnc 800]] Then click Send Code.

lines.label: enter-the-code
lines.said: A four-digit code is sent to that address. [[slnc 500]] Type it in — the screen moves on by itself.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: This is your dashboard. [[slnc 800]] A collection belongs to one store, so we start at Businesses.

lines.label: business-lookup
lines.said: Type the name of a business, [[slnc 500]] then select it from the dropdown list.

lines.label: the-business
lines.said: This is the business info page. [[slnc 500]] Click the lookup icon to find its stores.

lines.label: store-lookup
lines.said: Type the store name, [[slnc 500]] then select it from the list.

lines.label: the-store
lines.said: This is the store details page. [[slnc 800]] Click the gear, [[slnc 500]] then choose Lookup Collections.

lines.label: collection-list
lines.said: This lists the store's collections. [[slnc 500]] Click the plus button to add a new one.

lines.label: new-collection
lines.said: Give the collection a name, [[slnc 500]] then create it.

lines.label: collection-details
lines.said: Now the collection's own page. [[slnc 800]] Add a description, [[slnc 500]] set the starting price, [[slnc 500]] and update.

lines.label: collection-saved
lines.said: The collection is saved.

lines.label: back-collections
lines.said: Now we walk back the way we came. [[slnc 500]] The collections list.

lines.label: back-stores
lines.said: The store lookup. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: back-business
lines.said: The business page. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: back-dashboard
lines.said: And the dashboard. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: business-lookup-2
lines.said: Now back in, to add the collection's options. [[slnc 500]] Type the business name.

lines.label: the-business-2
lines.said: The business page again. [[slnc 500]] Click the lookup icon.

lines.label: store-lookup-2
lines.said: Type the store name, [[slnc 500]] then select it.

lines.label: the-store-2
lines.said: The store page. [[slnc 800]] Gear, [[slnc 500]] then Lookup Collections.

lines.label: collection-list-2
lines.said: Find the collection you just made, [[slnc 500]] and open it.

lines.label: collection-options
lines.said: Options are what makes a collection useful. [[slnc 1000]] This one is Ski Pole Length, [[slnc 800]] and its values are the lengths a renter can pick. [[slnc 1000]] Then update.

lines.label: dashboard-2
lines.said: Back at the dashboard. [[slnc 800]] A collection with no items cannot be rented, so now we add two.

lines.label: business-lookup-3
lines.said: Type the business name, [[slnc 500]] then select it.

lines.label: the-business-3
lines.said: The business page. [[slnc 500]] Click the lookup icon.

lines.label: store-lookup-3
lines.said: Type the store name, [[slnc 500]] then select it.

lines.label: the-store-3
lines.said: The store page. [[slnc 800]] Gear, [[slnc 500]] then Lookup Items this time.

lines.label: item-list
lines.said: This lists every item in the store. [[slnc 800]] Click the plus button to add the first pole.

lines.label: new-item
lines.said: Give the item a name. [[slnc 800]] Then choose the collection it belongs to, [[slnc 500]] and create it.

lines.label: item-details
lines.said: Now the item's details. [[slnc 800]] Set the quantity, [[slnc 500]] the price, [[slnc 500]] the requirement, [[slnc 500]] and the pole length. [[slnc 800]] Then update.

lines.label: item-saved
lines.said: The first pole is saved. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: back-items
lines.said: Back the way we came again. [[slnc 500]] The items list.

lines.label: back-stores-2
lines.said: The store lookup. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: back-business-2
lines.said: The business page. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: back-dashboard-2
lines.said: And the dashboard. [[slnc 500]]

lines.label: business-lookup-4
lines.said: Once more, for the second pole. [[slnc 500]] Type the business name.

lines.label: the-business-4
lines.said: The business page. [[slnc 500]] Click the lookup icon.

lines.label: store-lookup-4
lines.said: Type the store name, [[slnc 500]] then select it.

lines.label: the-store-4
lines.said: The store page. [[slnc 800]] Gear, [[slnc 500]] then Lookup Items.

lines.label: item-list-2
lines.said: The items list. Click plus.

lines.label: new-item-2
lines.said: The second pole is the same collection and the same shape as the first. [[slnc 1000]] Only the name and the length change. [[slnc 800]] Name it, [[slnc 500]] pick the collection, [[slnc 500]] and create it.

lines.label: item-details-2
lines.said: The details again. [[slnc 800]] Quantity, [[slnc 500]] price, [[slnc 500]] requirement, [[slnc 500]] and this time a hundred and twenty centimetres. [[slnc 800]] Then update.

lines.label: item-saved-2
lines.said: Both poles are saved. [[slnc 300]] The collection can be rented.

lines.label: dashboard-3
lines.said: Head back to the dashboard. [[slnc 500]] You can get here anytime with the command + K short keys.

lines.label: sign-out
lines.said: Click Logout to finish. [[slnc 500]] You are signed out.
